source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Once per battle for each unit, this unit may use this ability when it is **selected to shoot** in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). If it does, the ranged attacks of this model get +1 to **[hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** for the rest of that phase.

Mark this with a Boss’ Ammo Runt token beside the unit, removed when the ability is used.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.durationBasis: core rule 01.02.02 Persisting Rules Effects: no stated duration, so it lasts for the phase it was applied in
